## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b91d5d64232da3a128147a862fd463f0da11bd9e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md + scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs (the two added rows), references/cross-repo-coordination.md 规则 4 and L17, references/execution-duties.md L82, references/lanes/director.md L8, references/seat-lifecycle.md L12, and PR #25385 head `f08bab5c742a98a922145efd0a1fffd17294bfef` (the two one-line edits this PR drops)

Reviewed at 2026-10-23T13:33Z by an isolated reviewer of the `domain:skills` seat 2 session, from the card #25412 body with its 2026-10-23T12:25Z and 2026-10-23T12:27Z amendments, the seat claim (comment 6365006609), the diff `f0fdd45bb..b91d5d642` (6 files, +67 −6) and the head's check-runs. The PR body's self-assessment was not trusted; every claim below was re-derived from the committed tree. Angle brackets are written as 〈 〉 in this record so the sanitizer keeps them.

### ① Derived judgments

Card Wanted items against `references/project-forms.md` (new, 54 lines, six sections in the card's order):

1. One project form — L7 「车队项目 = 任一账号上、指令行指向 pm-dispatch 的 Claude Code 项目;⛔ 不分项目类型」; L8–L10 name 车道席 / 总监席 / 分诊席 as seats summoned by the maintainer into any project (「分诊与总监可召进任一项目,⛔ 不绑定项目」), carrying the 2026-10-23T12:25Z amendment. The account invariant is restated in one line, L11 「批准账号永不跑席位(SKILL.md 全体座位的不变量);本文不另加」, and SKILL.md L92 「批准账号永不跑席位或作其关联用户」 is untouched — not weakened. L12 confines logins to ruling records as evidence. Correct.
2. Instruction line is the summon — L16 `pm-dispatch 〈席位〉 [〈席位〉…]` with the card's examples; L17 first token = the skill directory name, 「⛔ 不用 `fleet`,它已是 bot 与中继的名字」, carrying the 2026-10-23T12:27Z amendment; L18–L19 the one-line mapping (总监 = `lanes/director.md`, 分诊 = `lanes/triage.md`, the rest by lane file name); L20 the several-seat-posts rule (🟢 names this account → vacant → ask once); L21 ⛔ no pasted template, ⛔ no account-level skill copy. Correct against the card. See ③-1 on the enumerated lane words.
3. Seats are read, not configured — L25 seats = the seat posts whose 🟢 names this account, read before any dispatch; L26 none ⇒ idle. Correct.
4. The instruction line is the assignment — L27 the only assignment act; L28 the long chat sentence as an equivalent form; L29 compared with the seat posts on every coordinator start, seat or take over per `seat-post-protocol.md`; L30 the account written into 🟢, one seat thread per seat, ⛔ no roster file; L31–L32 the routines (patrol every 2–4 h; 总监席 daily digest + hourly inbox scan; 分诊席 hourly bare-card run). Correct.
5. Takeover never waits for a walled account — L36 「🟢 行写着别的账号 ⇒ 指令行即维护者强制接管令,含在飞卡」; L37 never waits for the walled account's note; L38 cross-account `Release:` naming the old session and its 出处, new `Claim:` with `Resume-from: BRANCH@SHA`, the new dev continues the old branch; L39–L40 ledger = labels + assignee + `Claim:` + `head:claude/` PRs read by `assignee:〈旧登录名〉`, ⛔ project memory and the shared directory are never the ledger. Correct.
6. Mailbox PR — L44–L47: PR-bound talk needs nothing new; one draft PR per project, label `pm:mailbox`, branch `mailbox/〈login〉`, subscribed by a resident thread, never merged, closed on handover or account change, first body line `To: 〈login〉`, owes no CI, excluded from landing and ledger queries. Correct.
7. Roster board — L51–L53: pinned 「车队总表」, one row per seat, regenerated by the 总监席 digest and by seating/takeover/handover, the card's ten columns, read from seat posts, labels, assignees and PR queries, 「生成视图 ⛔ 不手改(`cross-repo-coordination.md` 规则 5)」. Correct.
8. Concurrency — L33 a per-project posture the maintainer sets, 「⛔ 不是协议常量,本文不写数字」. Correct; no number is written.

Edits elsewhere, each verified in place and line-neutral:

- SKILL.md: +1 〈阶段细则索引〉 row for `references/project-forms.md` (208 bytes against the 342-byte row pin); L49 opening line now reads 「`/pm-dispatch [args]` 或项目指令行 `pm-dispatch 〈席位…〉`,自由组合,全部可选:」; −1 the 〈全体座位的不变量〉 line 「一 PM 恰管一车道,一车道由一组座位管,一席一贴;PM Y 管什么恰一个答案」. Each clause of the deleted line still lives on this head: 「一 PM 恰管一车道」 and 「PM Y 管什么恰一个答案」 (the same statement: a PM's lane is exactly one) = `cross-repo-coordination.md` L36 规则 4 「一人恰一车道,一车道可坐多席」; 「一车道由一组座位管」 = 规则 4's 「一车道可坐多席」 plus L17 「车道可分席…每席独立座位贴」; 「一席一贴」 = `seat-post-protocol.md` L9 「多席车道每席一贴」 and `project-forms.md` L26 「每席恰一条席位线程、恰一车道,一席一贴」. No rule is lost. SKILL.md 319/319 on the base `f0fdd45`.
- `seat-post-protocol.md` L13: 「多场席(总监):`🟢` 后写召唤账号,状态块逐场一行(会话 ID + 锚);无在任者、无接管」 → 「直连多场总监席:`🟢` 后写召唤账号,逐场一行;项目席 🟢 即指派,接管见 `project-forms.md`」. The dropped 「无在任者、无接管」 for the direct-session 总监席 still stands at `lanes/director.md` L8 「⛔ 无接管无在任者」 and `seat-lifecycle.md` L12 「总监席多场并行、无在任者」; the dropped 「(会话 ID + 锚)」 is a format detail restated at `lanes/director.md` L19 「状态块逐场一行,各记己锚」. 91/91.
- `seat-lifecycle.md` L28: 「⛔ 不取在飞卡,由原认领者跟完」 → 「在飞卡归原认领者,不可达才接」. Necessary: the base line directly contradicted Wanted 5's 「含在飞卡」, and 「不可达」 is the protocol's existing takeover predicate (`execution-duties.md` L82 「认领人不可达(token 耗尽/会话结束/身份退役)⇒ 接管」). 95/96. See ③-3 on the card's wording for this file.
- `lanes/director.md` L7 「授权面 = 人工召唤,任一项目可召;…;直连 ⛔ 无 Routine/cron」 and L16 「…;例外 = `../project-forms.md` 例行」. Two lines where the card said one — judged necessary: with L16's 「⛔ 无任何例外」 left standing, SKILL.md L45 「两条细则冲突 ⇒ 按更严的一条行动」 would switch off the project 总监席's daily digest and hourly inbox scan that Wanted 4 writes. L22 「维护者令「必须人工决裁」撤销「有把握自己决定」」 and the human floor are intact; no ruling path is reopened to a seat. 70/70.
- `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈卡线程〉 and `rest-channel.md` are not touched here. Verified on #25385's head `f08bab5c`: `dispatch-runbook.md` L140 「派发令由 coordinator 写进卡线程开场消息,⛔ 不落共享目录;卡上派发评论留一行指针」 and `rest-channel.md` L62 「看板(org Project)field_values…」 are already there, as the claim foresaw (「may already be written by #25385; if so, drop it and say so」). Dropping them is correct; duplicating them would have conflicted.
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: a `CEILINGS` row `project-forms.md` 54 (landed count, headroom 0) and a `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` row 0; no other row moves. Correct.

Surface and invariants: the six changed paths are all inside the claim's file surface; no Tier H path (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/**`, `skills/**`, `.github/workflows/**`, CODEOWNERS) is touched; `references/triage-duties.md` is byte-identical to the base; `git grep -n 'os-bill\|hotlong\|os-elon-musk'` on `project-forms.md` at the head returns nothing; no rule line names a login as an assignment.

Budgets: `project-forms.md` 54 ≤ 60 with a ceiling row; SKILL.md 319/319, `seat-post-protocol.md` 91/91, `seat-lifecycle.md` 95/96, `lanes/director.md` 70/70 (ceilings read from the head's `CEILINGS` map); widest added or edited prose line 120 bytes (four lines at exactly 120: `project-forms.md` L11, L38, L53 and `lanes/director.md` L16), the one table row 208 bytes under the 342-byte pin.

Check-runs on the head: 52, all completed, none failed. `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (success) runs `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` (lint.yml L1035, L1045); `Type Check · source gates` (success) runs `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` and the frame-freshness self-test and scan (lint.yml L5516, L5554). `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard` and the four card/branch guards are success; the remaining jobs are success or skipped by path filter.

Merge compatibility (read-only `git merge-tree --write-tree`): against #25385's head `f08bab5c` clean, combined SKILL.md 318 lines, `lanes/director.md` 70; against #25422's head `03448dbb` clean, combined SKILL.md 319, `lanes/director.md` 87; the three heads together clean (SKILL.md 318, `lanes/director.md` 87, `seat-lifecycle.md` 95); against the current `main` tip `77392e90` clean, combined SKILL.md 318 against `main`'s ceiling 318.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` — consistent with the tree: no published package moves (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` and one ledger file under `scripts/pm`), so no changeset is owed and `skip-changeset` is the right form. Face = governed rule text ⇒ `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, which this record serves.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **Lane words overtaken by `main` (for the planned follow-up commit, ⛔ not a FAIL on this head).** `project-forms.md` L19 enumerates 「ui、skills、devx、cli、engine、services、spec、hotcrm」 exactly as the card lists them, but #25247 landed on `main` after this branch's base and folded `lanes/cli.md`, `lanes/engine.md` and `lanes/services.md` into `lanes/server.md` (SKILL.md on `main` now reads 「`domain:engine`/`domain:services`/`domain:cli` 读作 `domain:server`」). On the merged tree three of the eight words name charter files that no longer exist and `server` is missing. Exact fix, line-neutral, 113 bytes: 「- 其余席位词同 `lanes/〈lane〉.md` 文件名:ui、skills、devx、server、spec、hotcrm。」 — ride it on the post-#25385 commit the PR body already plans, and the seat re-reads that head.
2. **Two-form vocabulary left on #25385 — expected absence.** #25385's head still carries 「承办该车道的项目即「车道项目」」 (SKILL.md L54), 「所在项目即「总监项目」」 (L56), 「席位两形:Routine 席与项目席(会话是车道项目的线程)」 (L71) and 「五项健康指标进总监项目的每日摘要」 (`seat-lifecycle.md` L70), the vocabulary the maintainer withdrew at 2026-10-23T12:25Z. This head cannot touch them (they are #25385's hunks); the PR body commits to rewording them in one commit after #25385 lands. Listed here so the seat's landing check reads that commit, not this head, as the final one. Note also `seat-lifecycle.md` L26 and L95 and `execution-duties.md` L157 on #25385 say 「项目席」, which is a seat form, not a project type, and may stand.
3. **`seat-lifecycle.md`: a different line than the card named.** The card's one-line edit for this file (「the project forms do not use the self-bound cron or the cross-wall timer chain」) was already made by #25385, which deleted those three lines; this PR instead reconciles the in-flight clause of the 强制接管令 line, which the card's Wanted 5 contradicted. The chosen wording 「在飞卡归原认领者,不可达才接」 conditions the in-flight takeover on unreachability, which the card states only through its premise (a walled account); for the case the maintainer described (switching when a week's quota is spent) the two lines agree. If the maintainer means the instruction line to take in-flight cards from a reachable account too, this line is the one to loosen; nothing in the card says so today.
4. **SKILL.md L49 is a third touch.** The claim's SKILL.md surface reads 「the reference-table row only, paid by one deleted line」; the in-place edit of the 〈入口与角色〉 opening line (adding 「或项目指令行 `pm-dispatch 〈席位…〉`」) is inside the file, line-neutral, 93 bytes, reported in the PR body and carries Wanted 2 to the entry. Recorded as a surface deviation the seat should acknowledge in its ACCEPT, not as a breach that changes the verdict.
5. **PR body line that is stale.** 「`cross-repo-coordination.md` 规则 5 still says 「org Project 只是维护者的聚合视图」; … left for the seat」 is true of `main` but not of #25385's head, whose follow-up commit already carries 「看板(org Project)只是维护者的聚合视图」 at L44. No action beyond correcting the body.
6. **`main` moved since the base.** #25247, #25255 and #25393 landed after `f0fdd45`; the head's CI ran against the earlier `main`. The merge is clean and SKILL.md lands at 318 against `main`'s 318 ceiling, but the ratchet on the merged tree has no CI reading yet; the planned merge of `main` after #25385 produces it.
7. The PR body's first line is the project-session attribution HTML comment, reported by the thread as a deviation from `os-dev.md` 〈干净收尾〉; `main` (#25393) now names that exemption.

Independence: the diff was produced by the card thread on branch `claude/project-thread-s43tmc` (session `session_01UJebcS3m7vf3CYnTfBD5oH`); this record is rendered by an isolated subagent and adopted by the `domain:skills` seat 2 session named below. Both run under the same account as the PR author, so this is the seat's `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record, not the cross-account record #25422 will require once it lands; the card's own acceptance says the maintainer's 「#N 可以落地」 in the seat thread stands in until then.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-s43tmc`
Reviewed-by: `session_01REMuzhz6MWRjg8uohedMnM`

**VERDICT: PASS**
